format: 1-vs-1 sky-hop race to the moon: split-screen towers, each animal auto-bounces up its own lane of floating platforms (clouds low, asteroid rocks in space) toward the highest one it can reach; springs = super jump, cracked platforms crumble, misjudged hops = free-fall to a lower platform. Per-lane cameras so each lane's sky (day -> sunset -> dusk -> space) shows its height, centre altitude ladder, live height + LEAD chip HUD, slow-mo final leap, winner card, loop blend
theme: kangaroo vs frog (cute-animal 'who's the better jumper' 1-vs-1 matchup: big favorite vs small underdog, race to the moon)
viral_reason: VARIETY_RULES rule 2 own results: Windsor last_30dT for eas.ydata shows 1-vs-1 'X vs Y' matchups and country races on top (Country Clash ~1.4-1.6k views, Flag Drop #2 ~1.26k), and the animal 'who would win' matchup (shark vs octopus, 641 views) as the best non-country family; s3 yesterday was countries, so this is an animal head-to-head race. Rule 3 support: cute animals + underdog-vs-giant, instantly readable stakes. No aislop/research/latest.md in the Project.
music_style: gentle glitch/IDM: 122 bpm D lydian, pluck arpeggios over a sub bass, clicky kick + rim with stutter-tick bursts (new engine 'glitch' mood); boing hops pitched up a pentatonic ladder by height (kangaroo low, frog high, panned to their lanes), spring boings + bell, crack bursts, slide-down misses, bell sparkle on lead changes; drums drop out for the slow-mo final leap, moon bell chord + pluck fanfare on the card
caption:
Big jumps or quick feet: who reaches the moon first?

Kangaroo and Frog each bounce up their own tower of clouds and space rocks. Springs fling you sky-high, cracked platforms crumble underfoot, and one bad hop sends you tumbling back down. The lead flips six times before the final leap.

Are you riding with the kangaroo or the frog?

#kangaroo #frog #animalrace #tothemoon #simulation
